item.tib: ma mchog mkha' 'gro srid gsum dbang bsgyur ma tshe rabs gong nas zab gsang 'brel ba'i lha de'i bka' drin gdung shugs snying gi glu
item.coloph: ces bka' drin gsol 'debs gdung shugs snying gi glu dbyangs 'di ni/ rnal 'byor rang gi sems la'ang ma cig dpal gyi lha mo 'di yi thugs rjes/ dus cig min skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du skyong ba bu gcig gi ma ltar lags pa'i bka' drin yang yang dran pa dang*/ nye bar snying grogs tshe dbang lhun grub kyi (kyis) 'di lta bu dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ me 'brug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes la ke'u tshangs (tshang) nyi ma rang shar du bgyis pa/ kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis so//
